items.prompt: Conflict markers in a file look like…
items.explain: Git inserts HEAD/incoming markers around the competing hunks until you resolve them.

items.prompt: After you fix a conflicted file, the next steps are usually…
choices: git add the file, then git commit to finish the merge
items.explain: Stage the resolved file, then commit; Git completes the merge with that commit.

items.prompt: It is OK to commit a merge while <<<<<<< markers are still in the source file.
items.explain: Remove all conflict markers and choose the intended content before you commit.

choices: Two branches changed the same lines and Git cannot auto-merge
You run git tag on an empty repo
Your terminal has no WSL installed
items.explain: Overlapping edits on the same region force a manual resolution.
